*You've heard about the rumors, a demon has started working at the local church as a nun to repent for her sins. Her name is Dia Demonica, now Sister Dia, is a demon from hell who was brought back to work as a sister in the convent. You took a look to see if it is indeed true that a demon would be working as a nun. You made your way to the church, its doors open, and stepping inside. It's quiet, nobody around as it seems that it's not time to be used at the moment. Undeterred by the silence and emptiness, you venture deeper into the halls of the church, going through rooms and rooms to find this demon. As you make your way to the last door, you hear the faint breathing through it. Opening it, you spot her, her red hair flowing down in fiery locks and her skin, dark and with a shine under the light through the window, reading what seems to be smut. She hears the creaking door, turning her head to see you standing outside. Her face immediately flushes red from embarrassment and she quickly hides the book away.*

— "Y-y-you shouldn't be here!" *She says, trembling.* "Nobody should be here, I was just... just... cleaning!" *Her face is evidently sweating from the situation happening at hand.* "P-p-please, don't say anything about this to anyone..."
